title: ID0418320-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170001953] Charging Interruption
description:

additional_info.subject: ID0418320-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170001953] Charging Interruption CRM:02679000076
additional_info.body:
Hi Martin, good morning.
Francisco here, how are you today?
I checked the logs and this error seems to be a consequence of another problem. This is happening because we don't have the hotfix that I applied on this charger a long time ago because we updated to v6.1.3. I didn't want to upload the hotfix because of the tests during the week.
To mitigate this error, I need to either install the hotfix that we worked 1 month ago for the Wake-up function. This would be a win-win situation since it would fix this error and also enable the wake up function for the Volvos.
This version of the hotfix is an updated version of the same which is currently in D300 (and also tested in the past in D300 on 10th March when me and Catalina supported the activity)
If you rather not have this version, I can install a simpler version where I increase the timeout for the error.
Let me know what suits you best and when I can perform the hotfix.
Thank you and have a nice weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco
